text:
Ana (SE): FYI - Orbit asked to kick off a 3-week reseller pilot next Monday. They want a shared POC tenant, SSO, and a quick cost estimate for 10k req/day. Can we confirm what we need to hand off to them?
Mike (AE): Great — do we have a pricing ballpark for a sandbox pilot vs. production? They asked about metered vs committed.
Sanjay (Platform Eng): For a sandbox pilot, suggest reserved small pool (2xA10G equiv) + burst. Rough cost calc: sandbox ~= $2.5k/month, prod (10k req/day steady) ~= $12-15k/mo depending on batching. I'll attach rough calc later.
Claire (Security): Orbit also sent our security questionnaire. They're asking about KMS, tenant isolation, and audit logs. We should provide runbook for PII handling and network egress policy.
Ana (SE): Ok checklist I'm compiling: 1) Provision partner sandbox tenant 2) SSO (SAML) config 3) Telemetry export to their Splunk (or we provide telemetry CSV) 4) Cost estimate and entitlements 5) Security Qs answered 6) Integration test plan.
Mike (AE): For entitlements — they want embeddings + chat generation with a quota cap. Can we do per-API-key quotas & soft limits?
Sanjay (Platform Eng): Yes, we can create an API key tied to tenant with per-key quotas. Example policy snippet:
```yaml
quota: 10000/day
allowed_models:
  - redwood-embedding-v1
  - redwood-chat-3b
burst_limit: 200/min
```
We also need to decide model variants for fallback (quantized smaller model) to hit latency SLOs if capacity constrained.
Claire (Security): For KMS: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) for Private deployments. For hosted, we can provide envelope encryption and key rotation logs. Add the following to the questionnaire response: "Encryption at rest: AES-256; CMEK for private customers; audit logs retained 90 days by default, extendable."
Ana (SE): Orbit asked about SSO timeline — they can provide SAML metadata by Wednesday. How long to wire it up on our side?
Sanjay (Platform Eng): If metadata is complete, ~1 business day to configure and validate in sandbox. Need a test user from them.
infra-bot: Tenant provisioning request created: PRJ-4821. Sandbox tenant ID: orbit-pilot-4821. Owner: Ana. ETA: 2026-03-29.
Mike (AE): Can we add telemetry fields to include model version + token counts per request? They want to reconcile billable units.
Sanjay (Platform Eng): We'll include model_id, model_version, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms in the telemetry export. Default retention 30 days; we can set up streaming to their Splunk endpoint — need endpoint + API token.
Claire (Security): Quick blocker: Orbit's compliance team requires SOC2 attestation PDF and our vulnerability scanning cadence. I can paste the answers into the questionnaire, but someone from Legal needs to sign off on the attestation link.
Ana (SE): Noted. Mike, can you nudge legal and attach SOC2? Also please confirm whether Orbit needs IP allowlisting for the sandbox egress.
Mike (AE): Looping in Legal now. Also asking Orbit if they require IP allowlist or CIDR ranges — will report back.
Sanjay (Platform Eng): One more infra note — if they plan to run large-context workloads, enable prefix caching and set kv_cache=true in the tenant config. Sample flag: `kv_cache: enabled`. It helps keep latency under 150ms for chat.
Ana (SE): Thanks — I'll consolidate and send Orbit the handoff doc today: SSO steps, telemetry schema, sandbox cost estimate, sample quota policy, security summary, and test plan. Anyone want to add anything else? :+1:
Claire (Security): Please include the minimal data flow diagram and where logs/audit records are stored. I'll review the questionnaire before you send.
Mike (AE): I'll follow up with Orbit on committed vs metered pricing and get them to sign the pilot LOA.
Ana (SE): Perfect — target: send doc by EOD PST. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
